cells.quote: The results revealed that 1) the application of multimodal learning analytics in K–8 research is varied; 2) even though studies explicitly stated how multimodal data were collected and analyzed, they rarely mentioned the data fusion techniques and its process, and ethics and transparency; and 3) multimodal learning analytics has  the potential to improve learning outcomes, but more guidance and shared understanding are needed to conduct sound research using multimodal learning analytics.
